Cell.Data: Verification Plan for LC3 pipelined processor (UVM)
Every implemented opcode is fetched. Closed by every test.
12 bins: BR, ADD, LD, ST, AND, LDR, STR, NOT, LDI, STI, JMP, LEA. JSR, RTI, TRAP are not implemented by this LC3 and have no bins; RESERVED (1101) is an illegal_bin, so fetching it is an error.
ADD and AND in register and immediate mode. Closed by lc3_alu_test, test_top, lc3_base_test.
Every register in every register field of every instruction that uses it
7 bins: ADD, LD, AND, LDR, NOT, LDI, LEA
6 bins: ADD, AND, LDR, STR, NOT, JMP
Every SR2 or store-source reader reads R0-R7.
5 bins: ADD, AND (register mode only), ST, STR, STI
8 bins: R0-R7 (bits 2:0 for ADD/AND, bits 11:9 for stores)
Sign and magnitude of every immediate and offset field
Every offset user with a positive and a negative offset.
8 bins: BR, LD, ST, LDR, STR, LDI, STI, LEA
2 bins: positive, negative (bit 8 for PCoffset9, bit 5 for offset6)
Each field value class for each opcode that uses the field. Only the three crosses count; the six bare coverpoints have option.weight = 0. Closed by test_top, lc3_base_test, lc3_sweep_test.
Building block (weight 0): BR, LD, ST, LDI, STI, LEA
Branch conditions, branch offsets, jump bases
All 8 BR conditions. Closed by lc3_ctrl_test, test_top.
8 bins: never (000), p, z, zp, n, np, nz, nzp
Every BR word with nzp 001-111. nzp 000 offset 0 (0x0000) is excluded by known_dut_bug_c, so nzp 000 is counted only in branch_cg. Closed by lc3_sweep_test.
JMP through every base register. Closed by lc3_ctrl_test, lc3_sweep_test.
Back-to-back pairs (fetch order is execution order: no wrong-path fetch)
The very next instruction reads the register the previous ALU or load instruction wrote. Closed by test_top (HAZARD snippet).
2 bins: dependency through SR1/BaseR, through SR2/store source
Every opcode immediately after every opcode. Closed by test_top + lc3_base_test + lc3_ctrl_test (the sweep reaches ~132/144: JMP has only 8 encodings).
Every legal ADD, AND and NOT word. Closed by lc3_sweep_test.
4096 bins: op x DR x SR1 x imm5
1024 bins: op x DR x SR1 x SR2
Every legal LD, LDI, LEA, LDR, ST, STI and STR word. Closed by lc3_sweep_test.
Every LD, LDI and LEA word.
12288 bins: op x DR x PCoffset9
4096 bins: DR x BaseR x offset6
8192 bins: op x SR x PCoffset9
4096 bins: SR x BaseR x offset6
No mismatches in any test. fetch_in/fetch_out against the fetch model: PC, npc, enables
No mismatches in any test. decode_in/decode_out against the decode model: IR, control words, register fields
No mismatches in any test. execute_in/execute_out against the execute model: aluout, pcout, NZP, controls
No mismatches in any test. memaccess_in/memaccess_out against the memory-access model: Data_addr, Data_din, Data_rd, memout
No mismatches in any test. control_in/control_out against the controller model: enables, bypasses, br_taken, mem_state
No mismatches in any test. writeback_in/writeback_out against the register-file model: written value and register
No mismatches in any test. LC3_MEMORY_SUMMARY: every instruction and data access paired, none left over
Each test must run and pass
Coverage-directed snippets: hazards, branches, corner constants, jumps, indirect accesses (test_top)
LD, LDI, LEA, LDR, ST, STI, STR only (lc3_mem_test)
